name: Colour Wave Text
description: A word whose letters take palette colours by position and pass each one on in a slow wave.

props.name: text
props.description: The text to colour. Font and size are inherited.

props.name: colors
props.default: water, seafoam, wisteria, plum, yuzu, camellia
props.description: Letter colours, given by position and advanced by one with each wave. The defaults are the palette tokens, deepened on light backgrounds so each holds 3:1 as display text.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds between waves. Waves pause off screen and stop under reduced motion.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Milliseconds between one letter dipping and the next.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapping span. Other span props are passed through.
